headline: Portrait controllers fixed — one green nightly from shipping
lede: On an iPhone in portrait, the full-pad controller ran off the right edge — only the D-pad and stick were reachable. The fix re-stacks it into Sony-style rows: shoulders on top, d-pad and face-button circles mid-screen, the stick below, translucent over the game; anything that still overhangs shrinks uniformly instead of clipping. Proven in Safari's WebKit and Chromium at 320–430pt with real touch taps; #3959 sits green-gated on the required check, merging at the next nightly verdict.

notes.text: #3939 fix in review (#3959): portrait FULL PAD re-stacks into Sony rows (shoulders / d-pad circle + face circle / stick), translucent over the game — Jon's override, exactly. static already green.
New padFit law: whatever the pad draws must fit the usable width, or the whole pad shrinks by ONE honest factor — every pad type, every game, re-fitting even through Safari's toolbar collapse.

New gate npm run padfitcheck: 154 asserts across Chromium AND WebKit at 320/375/393/430 portrait — zero clipped controls, zero page errors, real taps landing ArrowUp/Space/KeyZ; proven red against the old law.

The #2176 quarantine only gated run-checks.mjs — the required static job ran the quarantined checks raw and held every PR red. Fixed on the merge path: static now consults quarantine.json and names the debt (#3952/#3953 still own their entries).
